text:
anya: Heads-up: ap-southeast1 saw a burst of GPU attach failures around 02:50 UTC. quick triage shows local NVMe write bursts during cleanup windows.
sam: which hosts? logs?
anya: sample node: gnode-apse1-127. dmesg: 
```
[  142.987654] nvme nvme0: I/O error, namespace 1, lba 987654321
[  143.002345] khugepaged: writeback failed, dev nvme0n1
[  143.012000] provisioner: attach timeout while allocating scratch
```
maria: did we push janitor changes?
kai: we bumped janitor_parallel from 4 -> 10 last night for faster reclaim; likely culprit.
anya: impact: ~25% attach failures for 6-9m, most retried OK but increased job start latencies. internal batch only so far.
sam: quick mitigation: reduce janitor_parallel to 3 on a 5-host canary and set a per-host iops soft cap (wkB/s -> 45k). route new allocs to eu-west as a safety.
maria: set a 20m rollout hold, watch nvme %util and attach latency histograms.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026 created for ap-southeast1 nvme saturation (severity: medium)
kai: opened PR to gate big rewrite passes on nvme_util < 80%: https://git.internal/redwood/janitor/pulls/450
anya: canary flipped, util dropped within 90s. expanding region if stable. :thumbsup:
